name: Formbricks
description: Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform and an alternative to Qualtrics. It runs link, website and in-app surveys with logic, multiple languages, hidden fields and partial responses, and passes responses on through webhooks, the API and integrations such as Slack, Notion and Zapier. This script builds the web app from source and runs it with PostgreSQL, Valkey and SpiceDB, which Formbricks 6 uses for authorization.
